nodes.Oar_L: oar, pivot at its oarlock, blade along +X (outboard)

rower.note: seat top of the middle thwart; place the avatar so its hips sit on it (measure the hips bone at runtime, do not hard-code)

stroke: sync to the Row clip phase t = 0.5 - 0.5*cos(2*pi*phase): t=0 catch (blade forward, in the water), t=1 finish; oar yaw sweep about +-28 deg, blade lifts ~10 deg on the recovery
